verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly detail multiple multi-agent orchestration patterns: agent delegation (one agent calls another as a tool), programmatic agent hand-off (application code invokes a second agent), and graph-based control flow for complex workflows, plus durable execution for long-running multi-step/human-in-the-loop workflows. This is first-party documented and structured as a core capability, though community evidence largely discusses single-agent use rather than corroborating multi-agent orchestration at scale. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of multi-agent handoff in production, and more detail on 'crew'-style parallel multi-agent coordination beyond delegation/hand-off/graph patterns.
